answer: Because a replay check that hashes every submission against the last 12 epochs costs roughly 4 hours of engineering and catches the duplicate before vesting, the jury draw can require five distinct subnets and 30 hours of separated history without slowing honest agents. The clawback then lands at 100% and the copied payout never leaves escrow. Vesting pushes the reward past the horizon of one epoch. A copycat voyage ends on the knoll with its bond forfeited.
